title: Fix mechanics audit evidence for inventory quantities and rollback retries
description:
Discovered during the eshyra-eh54 adventure-module/equipment playtest (ESHYRA_DEBUG_SESSION=full ... play).

A player authorized inventory mutation: 'Give bob a sensible starting kit for a 1st level fighter'. The DM correctly attempted give_item calls, but the turn was rejected:

  turn rejected by mechanics audit after retry: missing required tool(s) [give_item (target: Bob's starting kit quantities (10 torches, 10 days of rations, 20 crossbow bolts))] ... The response asserted exact item quantities that were not established by the executed tool calls.

This is NOT an adventure-module bug and NOT a 'DM refused to act' bug. There are two confirmed root causes in the orchestrator/audit layer:

ROOT CAUSE A — audit evidence lacks quantity-bearing detail.
- give_item returns only { applied: true, id, name } (packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolGiveItem.ts ~line 88). It does NOT echo the applied quantity, location, or target character, even though those args were passed and applied.
- The auditor's per-call summary (summarizeExecutedCall in packages/core/src/orchestrator/turnAuditor.ts ~line 188) includes only { tool, source, ok, data(truncated) } and NEVER the original sanitized tool-call arguments.
- Result: the auditor sees that give_item was applied for 'torch', 'rations', 'crossbow-bolt' but has zero evidence of quantities, so it cannot verify a response that says '10 torches, 10 days of rations, 20 crossbow bolts' and rejects it.

ROOT CAUSE B — unsafe retry after rollback.
- Rejected candidates are rolled back via the per-attempt SQLite SAVEPOINT (eshyra_turn_attempt) in packages/core/src/orchestrator/orchestrator.ts (ROLLBACK TO / RELEASE around lines 535-544).
- The corrective/retry note (formatCorrectiveNote in orchestrator.ts) only tells the model to fix the missing quantities. It does NOT tell the model that the prior rejected tool calls were rolled back and no longer apply. The retry must replay the ENTIRE intended accepted state change from scratch, otherwise it builds on state that no longer exists.
design:
Two coordinated changes:

1. Enrich audit evidence (turnAuditor.ts summarizeExecutedCall + the ExecutedToolCall plumbing): include the original SANITIZED tool-call arguments alongside the result, and/or have mutating tools echo applied state. At minimum give_item / remove_item evidence must carry item id, name, quantity, location, and target character when present. Prefer enriching results (toolGiveItem.ts / toolRemoveItem.ts return objects) AND/OR including sanitized args, so the auditor can verify quantity-sensitive assertions. Keep the bounded/sanitized property of audit evidence — do not dump unbounded payloads.

2. Retry corrective text (formatCorrectiveNote in orchestrator.ts): explicitly state that rejected candidate tool calls were rolled back and cannot be relied on, and that the model must recreate the full intended accepted outcome from scratch (all required tool calls, with quantities/targets), not just patch the previously-claimed-but-rejected difference.

remove_item already returns removed/previousQuantity/newQuantity (toolRemoveItem.ts ~204) — align give_item to echo comparable applied detail.
acceptance_criteria:
- A response claiming "10 torches" is accepted ONLY when executed give_item evidence includes quantity 10 for torch.
- A response that calls give_item without quantity, or with quantity 1, and claims "10 torches" is REJECTED.
- Retry after a rejected candidate does not assume any prior tool calls applied; corrective text explicitly says the previous candidate was rejected, all candidate tool calls were rolled back and did not apply, and the full intended outcome must be recreated from scratch with all required quantities and targets.
- Audit evidence for give_item/remove_item includes item id, name, quantity, location, and target character when present, while remaining bounded and sanitized.
- Cover quantity-bearing audit evidence, unsupported-quantity rejection, supported-quantity acceptance, and rollback-aware corrective retry text with unit/fixture tests only; no generated SRD runtime pack is required.
- The full real-SRD sensible fighter starting-kit playtest regression is explicitly out of scope here and moved to eshyra-12c3 because it depends on generated SRD runtime adoption and equipment lookup normalization.
notes:
Likely files: packages/core/src/orchestrator/turnAuditor.ts (summarizeExecutedCall, buildAuditUserMessage, ExecutedToolCall shape), packages/core/src/orchestrator/orchestrator.ts (retry loop, SAVEPOINT rollback ~431-550, formatCorrectiveNote, formatAuditFailure), packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolGiveItem.ts (~line 88 result), packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolRemoveItem.ts (RemoveItemResult ~204). Tests: packages/core/test/orchestrator.test.ts (rejection/retry/rollback ~1081-1513), packages/core/test/turnAuditor.test.ts, packages/core/test/inventoryQueryGuard.test.ts, packages/core/test/tools.test.ts. Discovered-from: eshyra-eh54 equipment playtest.
RULES-PACK RECONCILIATION (re: eshyra-t2ra / ADR 0013): The mechanics-audit evidence + retry/rollback fix in this bead is INDEPENDENT of the in-code DND5E_SRD_RULES_PACK placeholder discovery. Even once the generated SRD pack is loaded at runtime (eshyra-t2ra), the auditor must still receive quantity-bearing evidence for quantity-sensitive tool calls: summarizeExecutedCall currently omits the original call args and toolGiveItem returns only minimal { applied, id, name }. The retry-after-rejection prompt fix (rejected candidates were rolled back; recreate the full intended accepted outcome from scratch) is likewise a separate concern. Therefore this bead is NOT made hard-dependent on eshyra-t2ra; only the full end-to-end starting-kit integration test should follow t2ra.
SCOPE COORDINATION (2026-06-21): Keep this bead focused on mechanics-audit quantity evidence and retry-after-rollback behavior. Unit/fixture coverage is required for supported and unsupported quantity claims and the rollback-aware corrective note. The full real-SRD sensible 1st-level fighter starting-kit integration regression has moved to eshyra-12c3; hlte does not depend on 12c3.
PR REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (2026-06-21): Scoped remove_item metadata prefetch to the same resolved character predicate as removeItem. Added regression proving a targeted no-match cannot report another character inventory row metadata and does not mutate that row.
close_reason: Implemented bounded/redacted quantity-bearing inventory audit evidence and rollback-aware full-replay corrective retry text with unit/fixture coverage; full real-SRD starting-kit integration remains on eshyra-12c3.
